entries.description: For Python code you trust, this starter declares a setting, an asynchronous operation, and a managed image output. Its declaration is packaged as lynewright-manifest.json and read by the API without importing the package; unless trusted in-process execution is enabled, provider code loads in the runner. Its tests keep the package invisible while unlisted, then allowlist it and run its async operation through a production line.
entries.name: Native Python Example
entries.summary: A trusted-code starter with an async operation and managed image output.

entries.description: This starter exposes one read-only echo tool over Streamable HTTP. Its test starts the local MCP server, imports the declaration, discovers and approves the tool, maps it to the testkit contract, then runs it through a production line. Replace the example tool and integration declaration while keeping approval explicit.
entries.name: MCP Example
requires_operator_setup: Start the MCP example service, map it with LYNEWRIGHT_INTERNAL_ENDPOINT__<REF>, and enter <REF> when installing.
entries.summary: A read-only echo tool over Streamable HTTP.

entries.description: This starter provides a synchronous health check and an asynchronous job endpoint. Its tests start a local FastAPI service and run both operations through a production line with lynewright-testkit; the first job poll is pending and the next is done. Replace the example routes, schemas, and operation IDs with your service contract.
entries.name: OpenAPI Example
requires_operator_setup: Start the OpenAPI example service, map it with LYNEWRIGHT_INTERNAL_ENDPOINT__<REF>, and enter <REF> when installing.
entries.summary: A health check and asynchronous job API.
